How it works

  1. Weight against the breed's usual weight picks the build: under 85% slim, over 120% chonky. Legs come from the breed.
  2. Coat colors can come from the pet's photo (the app already reads them). Guessing build from a photo needs the vision model.
  3. Next: swap these in for the placeholder bodies in the app (with Minsik, scene.ts).
